(1)cho ga'i sngon 'gro rnams grub nas/mkha' 'gro snying thig gsol rjes/mkha' 'gro'i las byang gi lhan thabs mjes rgyan bzhugs so/rigs lnga ra

tei:div.tei:p: cho ga'i sngon 'gro rnams grub nas/ mkha' 'gro snying thig gsol rjes/ mkha' 'gro'i las byang gi lhan thabs mjes rgyan bzhugs so/ rigs lnga rigs kyi ḍāk+ki lnga la phyag 'tshal lo/ de la byor ba sngon 'gro'i yan lag tu/ skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro bdag la dgongs/ rkang gnyis gtso bos sangs rgyas thams cad dang*/ chi ba chags bral dam pa'i chos rnams dang*/ tshogs mchog 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad la/ bdag ni gus pas skyabs su nye bar mchi/ lan gsum bya'o/ de nas sems bskyed pa la gnyis las dang po smon sems ni/ hoḥ bla ma kun dgongs su gsol/ 'di bzung byang chub ma thob par/ 'gro drug sems can thams cad la/ ma dang bu yi 'du shes gyis/ ma bsgral ba ranams bsgral ba dang*/ ma grol dgrol dang dbug byung phyir/ smon pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do/ zhes dang gnyis pa 'jug sems bskyed pa ni/ ho/ sngon gyi rgyal ba thams cad kyang*/ sdom pa la ni gnas pa ltar/ 'di bzung 'khor ba ma stong bar/ bla med 'jug pa'i byang chub sems/ bdag cag rnams kyis bskyed par bgyi/ phar phyin drug la slob cing sgrub/ brtson 'grus dag gis thams cad bsgral/ kun don tshul khrims gsum yang bzung*/ bdag gis sems bskyed sdom bzung nas/ ma grol dgrol dang ma brgal bsgral/ dbug dbyung mya ngan 'das la 'god/ mkha' 'gro'i las byang mthar phreng las/ 'gogs bskrad nyon cig cesalan gsum bya'o/ de nas bka' bsgo mtshams gcod grub nas/ sdom pa (2) bzung ba ni/ dkon mchog gsum bzung mi gtang ngo*/ rdo rje rigs kyi dam tshig tu/ rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya dang*/ byang chub sems ni spang mi bya/ rdo rje rigs kyi dam tshig yin/ rig 'jin rigs kyi dam tshig tu/ sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu gtong*/ rig 'dzin rigs kyis sdom pa yin/

pad+ma rigs kyi dam tshig tu/ theg pa gsum dang chos rnams bshad/ pad+ma rigs kyi sdom pa yin/ las kyi rigs kyi dam tshig tu/ 'gro ba'i don la brtson par bya/ las kyi rigs kyi sdom pa yin/ zhes lan gsum bya'o/ de nas gnas dang yo byad byin rlobs ni/ hrīḥ bdag gi thugs las 'od zer gyis/ rigs lnga'i rgyal ba ma lus pa/ byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo dang*/ mkha' 'gro tshogs bcas rgyud bsgul te/ mkhyod gnas nas thib gyis byon/ bdag nas rnams la sib gyis thim/ snang srid mkha' 'gro'i rol par gyur/ hūm̐/ bzhengs shig mkha' 'gro gnas nas bzhengs/ mkha' 'gro ris lnga dbyings nas bzhengs/ mnyam nyid dbyings nas sku bskyod 'tshal/ rig 'dzin rgyan cha khro lo lo/ gser gyi gdu bu si li li/ rgyan cha mang po su ru ru/ glu len gar byed khyugs se khyug rig 'dzin dgos 'dod spungs se spung*/ dngos grub sna tshogs chi li li/ phying dngos grub zad mi mnga'/ sgrub pa po la dngos grub stsol/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥm ha ri ni sa ra tsa hrīḥya sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐/ hūm̐/ bzhengs shig mkha' 'gro gnas nas bzhengs/ mkha' 'gro sde drug gnas nas bzhengs/ bde chen gnas nas sogs/ oṃ āḥ(3)hūm̐ yaṃ hrīṃ mo hring hring hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐/ hūm̐/ bzhengs shig mkha' 'gro gnas nas bzhengs/ khwa gdong legs mkha' 'gro rnams/ sgo bzhi'i gnas nas sogs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ dzaḥhūm̐ bai ho sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐/ hūm̐/ bzhengs shig mkha' 'gro gnas nas bzhengs/ mkha' 'gro nyer brgyad gnas nas bzhengs/ dur khrod gnas nas sku bsgyod 'tshal/ rin chen rgyan cha khro lo lo/ sogs nas/ sgrub pa po la dngos grub stsol/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hūm̐ moṃ hrīḥha/ hūm̐ ma hrī ha sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐/ de ltar byin dbab nas/ mchod pa byin gyis rlobs pa ni/ swā bhā wa'i sngags kyis rdzas rnams bsang nas/

oṃ āḥbadz+ra puṣ+pe hūm̐ sogs nas/ shab+da hūm̐/ bar snang*/ oṃ sarba pañca amṛ taṃ a hūm̐/ oṃ ma hā rak+ta a hūm̐/ oṃ ma hā bha ling+ta a hūm̐/ lan gsum gyis brlabs nas/ dngos gzhi ḍāk+ki'i rkyangasgrub bam/ mngon rtogs rgyas par spro na/ rig rtsal rang dang ldan pas/ oṃ mi gnas mi dmigs chos sku de bzhin nyid/ āḥ kun snang kun khyab 'gro la snying rje bsgom/ hūm̐/ stong nyid snying rje dbyer med dam phris kyis/ hrīḥ thabs shes nyi zla rtog med bai gyi steng*/ skad cig rang rig mkha' 'gro'i sku ru gsal/ zhes ti nge 'dzin rnam pa gsum sngon du 'gro bas/ khyad par rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ bskyed pa rkyen gyi sngags kyis sku gsal gdab pa ni/ ngag tu/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥm ha ri ni sa ra tsa hrī ya zhes brjod pas/ bdag rdo rje phag mor bsgom ste/ sku mdag dmar me (4)zha gcig phyag gnyis ma/ mkha' 'gro zhal dmar mo spyan gsum ma/ phyag g.yas na gri gug dang*/ g.yon thod pa khrag gis bkang ba bsnams pa/ kha ṭ+wām̐ ka mchan khung g.yon na bcug nas 'dzin zhing*/ dbu sgra thur du 'phyang ba/ me long dang dril bu'i sgra 'khrol ba/ zhabs g.yon brkyang zhing g.yas bskum pa rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ mi re 'bar ba'i klong na ro'i gdan la phyed skyil du bzhugs par bsgom/ de ltar du bsgom pa'i spyi gtsug glad pa dung khang gi gzhal yas khang du/ rtse mo rnam par bkod pa rtsa 'das sum brgya dang*/ drug bcu'i lte ba'i rtsa mdud kyi dbus na 'byung ba chu'i dwangs ma/ pha ma'i rgyu'i thig le dkar po la/ ye shes kyi rang 'od kha dog lnga ldanadu gsal ba/ yi ge ha dang ra'i ngo bor gnas pa rdo rje mkha' 'gro yab yum sku mdog dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga dang phyag g.yon ka pā la bsnams pa/ ro'i gdan la yab yum gnyis med du 'khril ba/ sku mdog phyag mtshan yab dang mthun par bskyed do/

rtsa 'dab sum brgya drug cu la rdo rje rigs kyi mkha' 'gro sku mdog dang phyag mtshan gtso bo yab yum dang mthun pa/ thams cad kyang yab yum 'khril sbyor du bde stong gnyis med kyi ngang la bzhugs pa'o/ de yang ye shes lnga'i rtsal gyi rnam pa khro bo dang khro mo'i rang bzhin du bzhugs pa/ de yang gdod ma nas ye shes kyi rang rtsal 'byung bzhi'i dwangs ma yi ge dang sku ru rang byung lhun gyis grub pa'o/ mgrin par (5)ro rnams 'dus pa'i rtsa 'dab bcu drug gi lte ba'i rtsa mdud du 'byung bzhi'i dwangs ma pha ma'i khu khrag gi thig le yi ge ri dang tsa rnams ser po la ye shes kyi rang 'od kha dog lnga ldan du gnas pa/ rat+na ḍāk+ki yab yum gnyis sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ yab yum gnyis kyi phyag g.yas na rin che 'bar ba/ g.yon thod pa bsnams pa zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum pa/ rat+na'i gdan la 'khril byor du bskyed do/ de'i phyi rol gyi rtsa 'dab bcu drug la rin chen rigs kyi mkha' 'gro bcu drug sku mdog dang phyag mtshan gtso bo dang mthun par bskyed do/ snying ka nas dran pa rnam par bkod pa rtsa 'dab sum cu rtsa gnyis gyi lte ba la tsi t+ta rin chen zur brgyad kyi nang na ye shes kyi dwangs ma rgyu'i thig le snang la rang bzhin med pa mthing ka la ye shes kyi rang 'od kha dog lnga ldan du dngas pa/ yi ge ma dang hūm̐ gi rang bzhin du gnas te/ de'ang sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro kun tu bzang ngam sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag mtshan med pa yab yum 'khril sbyor du bzhugs pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa zhabs brkyang bskum nyi zla'i gdan la bzhugs pa/ de'i phyi rol gyi rtsa 'dab sum cu rtsa gnyis la sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro yab yum sum cu rtsa gnyis rgyan dang cha lugs gtso bo dang mthun par bskyed de/ lte ba na skyed byed drug cu rtsa bzhi'i rtsa 'dab gyi dbus gyi lte ba la/

'byung bzhi'i dwangs ma pha ma'i rgyu'i thig le kha dog dmar po la/ ye shes kyi rang 'od kha dog lnga ldan du gsal (6)ba ni yi ge ni dang hrīḥ'i ngo bor gnas pa/ pad+ma mkha' gro yab yum sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas pa gnyis na pad+ma bsnams pa/ g.yon gnyis na thod khrag bsnams pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum pa pad+ma'i gdan la rol ba'o/ de'i phyi rol gyi rtsa 'dab drug cu rtsa bzhi la pad+ma mkha' 'gro yab yum drug cu rtsa bzhi sku mdog dang phyag mtshan gtso mo dang mthun par bskyed do/ gsang gnas bde ba myong byed rnam par bkod pa'i rtsa 'dab nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi lte ba'i rtsa mdud la 'byung bzhi'i dwangs ma pha ma'i khu khrag gi thig le kha dog ljang ku la ye shes gyi rang 'od kha dog lnga ldan du gsal ba/ yi ge sa dang ya'i ngo bor gnas pa de las gyi mkha' gro yab yum sku mdog gi ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas ral gri dang g.yon thod pa brnams pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum pa/ rdo rje rgya gram gyi gnad la yab yum 'khril sbyor du bskyed do/ de'i phyi rol gyi rtsa 'dab nyi shu rtsa b.ragayad la las kyi rigs kyi mkha' 'gro yab yum nyi shu rtsa brgyad po sku mdog dang phyag mtshan gtso mo dang mthun par bskyed do/ lha'i de kho na nyid kyi don yang*/ de yang rang las rdo rje phag mor gsal ba/ phyi ltar na yab yum chen mo shes rab gyi phrol du phyin ma/ nang ltar na rdo rje phog gam gsang ba ltar yab yum e ka tsa ti'i rang bzhin gnas pa'o/ snying ka'i yab yum kun tu bzang ngom yang*/ phyi ltar na 'byung ba nam mkha'i ngo bo/ nang ltar mo gsang ba (7)chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes so/ gzhan yang mkha' 'gro bzhi yang*/ phyi 'byung ba bzhi/ nang lha mo bzhi/ gsang ba ltar na yi ge bzhi'i ngo bor gnas pa'o/ dpa' bo bzhi yang phyi nyon mongs pa bzhi/

nang dpa' bo ging bzhi/ gsang ba yi ge bzhi'i ngo bor gnas pa'o/ rang gi lus kyi lha yab yum gnyis su med pa/ thabs dang shes rab gyi rang bzhin du gnas pa'o/ ces dang las byang spyan 'dren pa bstod pa'i bar btang nas/ rang gi snying gi dkyil sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro yab yum gyi snying gar pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i dkyil du yab yum gnyis gyi sa bon la ha ri ni sa ra tsa hrīḥya brgyad kyis bskor ba cos skor du ska ra ra 'khor bar bsam la/ ha ri ni sa ra tsa hrīḥya tsit+ta hrīṃ hrīṃ ja jaḥ zhes bzlas/ mkha' 'gro rnams kyang rang gi snying po di ri ri bzlas par bsam mo/ rdzogs rim gyi rnam par ni/ mkha' 'gro lnga po de yang phyi ltar na sku lnga/ nang ltar na mkha' 'gro lnga/ gsang ba yi ge lngar bltas la bzla'o/ rdzogs rim gyi de kho na nyid kyi don yang phyi ltar na sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro yab yum chos sku/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro yab yum longs sku/ rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro yab yum sprul sku/ pad+ma mkha' 'gro yab yum ngo bo nyid sku/ las kyi mkha' 'gro yab yum mngon par byang chub pa'i skur bltas la bzla'o/ nang ltar na sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro yab yum gti mug rnam par dag pa/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro yab yum zhe sdang rnam par dag pa/ rin chen mkha' 'gro yab yum nga rgyal rnam par dag pa/ pad+ma mkha' 'gro yab yum 'dogs rnam par dag pa/ las kyi mkha' 'gro yab yum phrag dog rnam par dag par shes nas bzla'o/ gsang ba ltar na ye shes lnga ni sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro yab yum (8)chos dbyings ye shes/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro yab yum me long ye shes/ rin chen mkha' 'gro yab yum mnyam nyid ye shes/ pad+ma mkha' 'gro yab yum sor rtog ye shes/ las gyi mkha' 'gro yab yum bya ba grub pa'i ye shes kyi nges pas bzla'o/ de ltar bzlas pas mkha' 'gro yab yum rnams zhal mngon sum du mthong*/ sku lnga lhun gyis grub/

dug lnga gnas su dag ye shes lnga rang bzhin gyis 'char/ 'gro ba rang bzhin gyis skye rgyun chad/ skye shi la nyams mi nga bar 'byung ngo*/ yang skabs su rig rtsal ngar gdags te/ lta ba sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma/ cir yang ma grub rang bzhin yin/ bsgom pa rdo rje mkha' 'gro ste/ mi 'gyur mi shig sgom dang bral/ spyod pa rin chen mkha' 'gro ste/ kun mthun rang byung rang shar ba'o/ 'brus pad+ma mkha' 'gro ste/ 'khor ba ma spang rang sar grol/ dam tshig las gyi mkha' 'gro ma/ 'gro don thabs mkhas phrin las mdzod/ ces gsal gdab po/ de nas tshogs rtsar phreng ltar btang nas/ dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni/ slar yang lha snang cher gsal gdab nas rang gi snying ka'i 'od kyis snod bcud thams cad phog pas de thams cad 'do dang zer du dag nas rang la thim/ rang nam mkha' la 'ja' tshon yal ba ltar dmigs bsam spros pa dang bral ba'i ngang la bzhag go de nas rtsa sngags brjod pa'i rkyen gyis chu las rlabs 'phyo ba'i tshul gyis rdo rje phag mor skad cig gis gsal ba'i gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis mtshan pa'i nga rgyal la gnas nas spyod lam la 'jug par bya'o/ bkra shis kyi mgor smon lam gdab pa ni/ mkha' 'gro ma yi dkyil 'khor du/ bskyed dang rdzogs pa'i rim pa bsgom/ gsang sngags bzlas pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ shes pa bzhi yang 'byung ba (9)dang*/ rtogs pa nyams su myong ba dang*/ rig pa khong nas shar nas kyang*/ rkyen ngan grogs su chod par shog mi phod brdzi zhing 'khri ba chod/ mi mthun ngos zin mtshungs yul 'don/ rig pa dri ma mi gnas par/ rang rig bla mar 'char bar shog 'khor dang bu med zas nor 'du/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong sngags btsun 'du/ skye bo rgyal 'bangs khrom tshogs 'du/ 'du ba gsum la byang chub nas/ lus la bde ba'abar ba dang*/ ngag la nus pa'i mthu 'bar zhing*/ sems la rtogs pa'i ye shes 'bar/ nyon mongs chos nyid grol bar shog

chos sku skye ba med pa dang*/ longs sku rig 'dzin 'gags pa med/ gang la gang 'dul sprul pa'i sku/ sku gsum lhun gyis grub par shog ces dang rtsar phreng oṃ āḥhūm̐ ngo bo rang bzhin sogs bkra shis kyang brjod do/ de ltar mkha' 'gro snying thig gi las byang rtsar phreng gi zhal skong zhig dgos par sgrub brtson bla ma dpal ldan gyis bskul ngor sngags btsun pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyis rtsa ba'i gzhung las btung pa'o/// /
